insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Orianna is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Orianna in 23/47 games (49%): 6 picks (2-4) and 17 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Jarvan IV? They go Aatrox
insights.text: Jarvan IV is a G1 favorite (7/25 G1s, played by ISMA). In the 14 later games where it was burned or banned, ISMA went to Aatrox (2/14) and Vi (2/14).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Orianna
insights.text: Orianna is their first ban in 14/47 games (30%). Expect it gone before your first pick.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 8 G3+ games, 14/40 picks (35%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 50 champs in G1s, 31 in G3+.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Orianna against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Orianna against them in 20/47 games (43%).
